About Teal
Teal is a career management platform that provides AI-powered tools to help job seekers optimize their resumes, track applications, and match job descriptions. With over 2 million users and 100,000 subscribers to Teal+, it offers both free and premium tools to simplify the job search process. Teal’s resume builder, job tracker, and Chrome extension enable users to stay organized and land jobs faster, making it a go-to resource for job seekers aiming to grow their careers efficiently.
